jobs.description:
Engagement Manager - Enterprise Corporates

About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an Engagement Manager to join our UK & Ireland Engagement team in London, own adoption across a portfolio of enterprise corporate clients and help some of the world's largest in-house legal functions fundamentally change the way they work.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of strategic enterprise accounts: building deep, multi-level relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser who turns Legora into an embedded part of how those teams operate.

Enterprise means depth: larger, more complex accounts with more revenue at stake. Each account is a global legal function with multiple teams, jurisdictions and business units, its own governance, and a long, multi-phase roadmap. Success depends on navigating that complexity: aligning General Counsel, legal operations, IT, security and procurement, and building momentum one team and one use case at a time until Legora is used across the whole function.

At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class enterprise adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Specifically, you will:

  • Design each client's enterprise adoption strategy: the change-management approach, governance model, stakeholder map across legal, business and IT, and target outcomes for how that legal function adopts Legora.

  • Execute against that strategy, sequencing initiatives from the first pilot teams through to function-wide and global adoption across regions, practice areas and business units.

  • Build and run executive governance with each client, including steering committees, executive business reviews and success plans owned jointly with GC and legal operations leadership.

  • Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands enterprise in-house legal priorities (cost, cycle time, risk, global consistency and doing more without adding headcount), surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora.

  • Navigate the enterprise landscape, including security reviews, IT and integration requirements, procurement and change-control processes, so that adoption keeps moving.

  • Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), keeping full account context and coordination.

  • Partner closely with GTM on renewals, expansion and other key commercial moments, building the case for wider deployment and new use cases across the client's organisation.

  • Turn customer feedback into action by working closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to shape the roadmap, positioning and enablement for enterprise clients.

  • Build reusable enterprise playbooks, governance templates and enablement material from what works, so the whole Engagement team gets better as you go.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:

  • At least 5 years' experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success, ideally with enterprise clients in an AI-native B2B vertical.

  • Experience leading large-scale rollouts and adoption programmes at enterprise or global organisations. We want someone who has taken a new way of working into a large, multi-jurisdictional in-house function, navigated procurement, IT, security and sceptical stakeholders, and made it stick.

  • A consulting or transformation background, with a track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, matrixed organisations.

  • Experience building multi-year, client-level transformation roadmaps and governance structures, and steering them to measurable outcomes.

  • Confidence engaging C-suite and General Counsel-level stakeholders, running executive reviews and building executive sponsorship.

  • Strong programme management: comfortable running complex, multi-workstream programmes with many stakeholders, dependencies and risks.

  • A track record of driving adoption, retention, expansion and satisfaction with enterprise clients.

  • Experience in legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries, or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.

  • Excellent communication skills, written, verbal and interpersonal. You can hold the room with a General Counsel and roll up your sleeves with the teams who use the product every day.

  • High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.

  • A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.

  • Fluency with metrics, and a focus on data, customer health and outcomes over process.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Head of Applied Research

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is building the next generation of AI technologies for the energy sector, and we're looking for an exceptional Head of Applied Research to help lead that ambition.

As the advanced technology platform powering some of the world's largest energy utilities, Kraken has a unique combination of deep energy domain expertise along with technological rigor in AI and optimisation, offering a unique opportunity to develop AI technologies that shape how energy systems operate.

Kraken has been investing in the development of energy-specific AI models and intelligent decision-making systems to power products that can understand, predict and ultimately help shape how energy is consumed, managed and distributed.

This isn't a traditional research lab. Our focus is on building technically ambitious, commercially valuable AI systems that solve real-world problems. We want to push the boundaries of what's technically possible while ensuring that the technology we develop translates into meaningful products, measurable impact and lasting competitive advantage.

Reporting into and working closely with our Chief AI Officer, you'll help define Kraken's applied research strategy, establish the technical foundations for our next generation products and cultivate an exceptional team capable of delivering them.

This is an opportunity for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ambition to build something genuinely new - someone who is equally comfortable with the latest literature in the field, making difficult technical decisions and turning breakthrough ideas into implementable products.

🏡 What you'll own

Shape Kraken's next generation of AI technology

  • Partner with our Chief AI Officer to define and execute Kraken's applied research strategy and roadmap, identifying the foundational capabilities and proprietary technologies that will create lasting competitive advantage.

  • Lead the development of advanced AI models and architectures designed to understand and model complex energy systems, behavior, and decision-making.

  • Explore and develop approaches using foundation models, deep learning, transformer architectures, representation learning as well as emerging techniques to unlock new capabilities.

  • Develop generalisable models capable of supporting multiple products and applications per client.

  • Establish a technical roadmap that balances ambitious innovation with practical development, scalability and commercial outcomes.

Develop and lead an exceptional technical team

  • Develop, lead a high-performing team of AI researchers, research engineers and data scientists.

  • Establish a culture of technological excellence, intellectual curiosity, experimentation and strong execution.

  • Remain close to the technology, providing hands-on technical direction, challenging data modeling and architectural decisions and helping solve complex modelling problems.

  • Attract and develop exceptional technical talent, creating an environment where highly capable individuals can do the best work of their careers.

  • Set clear technical priorities, development standards and measures of success while giving the team the autonomy to explore ambitious ideas.

Develop proprietary AI models and intelligent systems

  • Lead the design, development, training and evaluation of advanced AI models.

  • Develop models capable of learning underlying patterns in energy demand and system behaviour, with the potential to generalise across different applications and environments.

  • Advance intelligent decision-making capabilities that move beyond prediction towards sophisticated reasoning, control and optimisation.

  • Evaluate new architectures and modelling approaches against existing methods, with the ambition to achieve state-of-the-art performance in strategically important areas.

  • Ensure models are technically robust, scalable and capable of being integrated into real-world production environments.

Drive AI research that turns into meaningful products

  • Work closely with engineering, product and commercial teams to ensure Kraken’s technological research addresses core client needs, with the potential to translate into products that deliver measurable value for Kraken and its clients.

  • Help establish the infrastructure, tooling and development practices required to build, evaluate, deploy and continuously improve sophisticated AI systems.

  • Define clear measures of model performance and commercial success, ensuring technical development remains connected to meaningful outcomes.

  • Apply advanced AI models to realtime multi-modal agentic workflows in demanding production environments

  • Build reusable AI capabilities that can support multiple products and business opportunities rather than isolated, one-off solutions.

Influence Kraken's broader AI direction

  • Act as a senior technical authority, helping shape strategic decisions around AI technologies, architectures and investment priorities.

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to AI, machine learning and engineering teams across Kraken.

  • Establish high standards for experimentation, model evaluation and responsible deployment.

  • Stay at the forefront literature, developments inAI research, identifying emerging capabilities that could transform software products that underpin the energy industry.

  • Support technical assessments of potential AI partnerships and acquisitions, helping inform build, buy and partner decisions.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party

We're looking for an exceptional technical leader who has demonstrated the ability to develop advanced AI technology and turn it into real-world impact.

We're more interested in what you've built, the problems you've solved and the technical depth you bring than a particular job title.


Essential experience

  • Deep expertise in modern machine learning and deep learning, with a strong understanding of foundation models, model architectures, and data pipelines.

  • A proven track record of designing, developing or leading the creation of advanced AI models that have delivered measurable technical or commercial outcomes.

  • Strong technical knowledge of several areas such as transformer architectures, foundation-model training and adaptation, representation learning, time-series modelling, reinforcement learning and related machine learning techniques.

  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing models capable of identifying meaningful patterns, generalising across problems and operating at scale.

  • A strong understanding of the end-to-end model development lifecycle, including data preparation, training, evaluation, experimentation, inference and production deployment.

  • Experience building, leading or technically guiding high-performing teams of machine learning engineers, research engineers or applied AI specialists.

  • The ability to translate ambitious technical ideas into clear strategies, practical roadmaps and systems that create meaningful business value.

  • Strong technical judgement, including the ability to evaluate emerging approaches, challenge assumptions and make pragmatic decisions about where to invest.

  • The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence senior engineering, product and executive stakeholders.

Technical expertise

You'll bring significant depth in some of the following areas:

  • Foundation models, large language models and transformer-based architectures.

  • Large-scale pre-training, fine-tuning, distillation and model evaluation.

  • Time-series foundation models, representation learning and alternative approaches to structuring and tokenising complex data.

  • Reinforcement learning, decision-making models and learning-based optimisation.

  • Distributed model training and modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

  • Scalable data pipelines, training infrastructure, inference systems and production ML engineering.

  • Model evaluation, experimentation and techniques for improving performance, reliability and generalisation.

We don't expect you to be an expert in every area. What matters most is deep technical expertise, the ability to recognise promising approaches and the judgement to build the right capabilities around you.

⭐️ Bonus Points

  • PhD Machine Learning, neuroscience, Computer Science, Physics or a related discipline.

  • Experience developing foundation models or advanced AI systems using large-scale data.

  • Nice to have: experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand forecasting, grid flexibility or other complex physical systems.

  • Experience applying AI to scientific, industrial or real-world decision-making problems.

  • Experience developing novel model architectures or achieving state-of-the-art results in a commercially relevant domain.

  • Experience establishing a new technical team, capability or product area from an early stage.

They protect Kraken’s commercial position within the Sierra partnership, including customer ownership, costs, responsibilities and the route to scale. They can choose which accounts deserve attention, where senior involvement will make a difference and which opportunities should wait. Their forecasts stand up to scrutiny, and they spot slippage early.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Head of Financial Controller

🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

💼 Your Responsibilities

General Accounting Operations

  • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process

  • Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented

Multi-Entity Oversight

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

Controls, Risk & Governance

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

  • Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.

  • Grow the team to help support scalability and growth.

  • Support ad hoc business requests, including finance topics adjacent to accounting (e.g., payroll coordination)

🔎 Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years in accounting roles, including senior/lead or controller-level experience

  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards; exposure to multi-GAAP/consolidation environments is a strong plus

  • Proven ability to build processes and internal controls from scratch in a fast-growing or scaling environment

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and ambiguity; adapts quickly to change

  • Prior people management experience

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

Mechanical Engineer, Jigs & Tools

About the Role

The Destinus engineering team is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering jigs and tooling solutions as part of the research and development in the rocket motor department. In this role, you will design and develop equipment and machines for testing and production of our products. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience as a mechanical engineer with experience in industrialization projects, mechanical design and DFM with a demonstrated ability to take ownership during development and drive technical solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Take the technical lead for the Jigs and Tools development
  • Review product designs from a production point of view
  • Understand and evaluate the production steps and the needed tools
  • Research existing off-the-shelf components and combine them to a production solution
  • Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and other related documentation required for production.
  • Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions.
  • Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process.
  • Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables following best practices and industry standards.
  • Coach junior engineers and interns in jigs and tooling design, manufacturing and CAD.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions during different development stages.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, testing, and industrialization engineers, to ensure seamless integration and functionality of the components into the vehicle.

Requirements

Qualifications and Experience

  • BSc. In Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Ideally, technical training as a mechanical designer/drafter, Toolmaker or Mechanic
  • Min. 3 years of experience in mechanical engineering with close ties to jigs & tools for production
  • Knowledge of machining, sheet metal, composites and assembly processes, and of metrology and inspection methods.
  • Lean manufacturing knowledge is desirable.

jobs.title: Cloud Governance Engineer
jobs.description:
Cloud Governance Engineer

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

This is a governance role, not a build-and-operate role. You will spend your time defining the rules our cloud estate runs by, making those rules enforceable in code, and proving they are working. You will write standards that other engineering teams have to follow, and you will be the person who explains to Finance, Security, and Product leadership why a given risk matters and what it will cost to fix or ignore.

If what you want is to build and run infrastructure, this is not the right seat. If you want to own how a multi-cloud estate is governed, it is.

About our estate: roughly 70% Google Cloud, with AWS and Azure in scope as secondary platforms. GCP is where the majority of the work sits, so hands-on GCP experience is a hard requirement rather than a preference.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, document, and maintain cloud governance policies and standards across GCP, AWS, and Azure, and turn them into enforceable technical controls using GCP Organization Policy, AWS SCPs and Config, and Azure Policy
  • Own the exception and waiver process end to end: intake, risk assessment, time-bound approval, expiry, and follow-up
  • Partner with Security to enforce Identity and Access Management and network security standards across the organization, and review access models for least privilege
  • Build and maintain dashboards that track governance metrics: security posture, key and credential rotation, policy violations, configuration drift, and time to remediation
  • Own resource labeling and tagging standards and enforce them, so that cost, ownership, and environment can be attributed reliably
  • Drive cost governance: spend visibility and showback, anomaly detection, commitment and discount coverage reviews, and surfacing waste to the teams that own it
  • Collaborate with IT, Finance, Security, DevOps, Cloud Architects, and Product Engineering to keep governance controls consistent across all environments, and translate technical risk into language those stakeholders can act on
  • Work with stakeholders to define service level objectives, key performance indicators, and metrics for operational efficiency
  • Support the review of new third-party cloud services before they enter the estate

Requirements

  • 4+ years working in public cloud environments, including at least 2 years hands-on with GCP
  • Hands-on experience implementing preventative guardrails in at least one hyperscaler (GCP Organization Policy, AWS SCPs or Config, Azure Policy). You should be able to walk us through a policy you rolled out, what it broke, and how you handled the fallout
  • Experience authoring a cloud policy or standard that other teams were required to follow, not only implementing one written elsewhere
  • Experience running or contributing to an exception or waiver process for cloud controls
  • Working knowledge of cloud IAM, network security, encryption, and key and secret management
  • Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, and comfort extending it to policy-as-code
  • Python for automation, enforcement, and reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to explain a technical risk to a non-technical audience and drive a decision. This is a core part of the job and we will test it during the interview process

Preferred Qualifications

  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification
  • Policy-as-code tooling: OPA, Conftest, Sentinel
  • Cloud cost tooling: GCP billing exports and BigQuery, AWS Cost Explorer, or a third-party platform such as Cloudability or Apptio
  • Familiarity with the control frameworks our platform is audited against (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR). You will not own audits in this role, but context helps you prioritize
  • Kubernetes governance and policy enforcement
  • Okta integration, Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another relevant technical field
  • Result oriented, self-starter

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside outside Porto, Maia, Matosinhos, Gondomar, Valongo e Vila Nova de Gaia. Candidates who reside within those municipalities would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.

jobs.title: MSF International Managing Director
jobs.description:
MSF International Managing Director

Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva

Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years)

Starting date: 01st of March 2027

Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified.

Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract

*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International:

  • Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

  • Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

  • Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

  • Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

  • Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

  • Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

  • Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

  • Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

  • Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

  • Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

  • Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.


Education

  • Master’s degree in management, humanitarian affairs, political sciences, or a related field, or equivalent senior-level professional experience

Experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations

  • MSF experience is a major asset

  • Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level

  • Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership

  • Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems

  • Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies

Knowledge

  • Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values.

  • High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters.

  • Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset.

  • Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change.

  • Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally.

  • High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation.

  • Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate.

  • Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience.

Languages

  • Excellent English (written and spoken) is essential.

  • French highly desirable, and other MSF languages are further assets.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures.

jobs.title: Architecture Internship Dutch | March 2027 (2)

Architecture Internship Dutch | March 2027 (2)

Geef je carrière een vliegende start

MVRDV is een wereldwijd gerenommeerd architectuur- en stedenbouwkundig bureau met het hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en kantoren in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. MVRDV werd in 1993 opgericht door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries en zet zich in voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve, maatschappelijk verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft.

Als stagiair bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 200 professionals uit ruim 40 verschillende landen. Je doet praktijkervaring op in baanbrekende projecten, werkt samen met toonaangevende architecten en verlegt de grenzen van ontwerp en innovatie. Ben jij gepassioneerd over architectuur en wil je leren in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je.

Let op: We verzoeken recruitmentbureaus vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde kandidaten of profielen voor deze vacature aan te leveren. Wij verzorgen het wervingsproces intern en accepteren geen voorwaarden of vergoedingen met betrekking tot ongevraagde doorverwijzingen.

Sollicitatieprocedure

  1. Je kunt je sollicitatie indienen vanaf nu tot en met 16 november 2026.

  2. De gesprekken vinden plaats tussen 23 november en 11 december 2026.

  3. Succesvolle kandidaten starten op 1 maart 2027.

Belangrijk: Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze stage moet je gedurende de volledige stageperiode, van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027, ingeschreven blijven staan aan een daarvoor in aanmerking komende opleiding aan een universiteit of hogeschool.

Over het Design Collective

Het Design Collective van MVRDV is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve en duurzame gebouwen en constructies. We werken aan een breed scala aan projecten, van kleinschalige woningbouw tot grootschalige commerciële en culturele complexen. Bekijk enkele voorbeelden van onze projecten op: https://www.mvrdv.com/projects.

Het Design Collective richt zich op projecten in de volgende regio’s:

  • Nederland

  • Azië

  • DACH-regio

  • Franstalige landen

  • Noord-Amerika

  • Centraal- en Oost-Europa

  • Taiwan

  • Midden-Oosten

Over de functie

Als Architectuurstagiair bij MVRDV kom je terecht in een dynamische omgeving waar gedurfde ideeën en snel schakelen dagelijks centraal staan. Je wordt begeleid door internationaal vooraanstaande ontwerpers bij projecten en prijsvragen en levert een bijdrage aan ambitieuze concepten, gedetailleerde tekeningen en indrukwekkende visualisaties.

Afhankelijk van jouw profiel en ervaring word je gekoppeld aan specifieke projecten, regio’s en/of projecttypen.

Dit is een uitstekende kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, je creativiteit uit te dagen en een realistisch beeld te krijgen van het werken aan de voorhoede van de architectuur.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Assisteren bij de ontwikkeling van concepten en ontwerpvoorstellen.

  • Maken van tekeningen, diagrammen en 3D-modellen.

  • Ontwikkelen van visualisaties en presentatiemateriaal voor prijsvragen en opdrachtgevers.

  • Deelnemen aan teamoverleggen en ontwerpbesprekingen.

  • Onderzoek doen naar materialen, locatieomstandigheden en architectonische referenties.

Wat bieden wij?

Leren van marktleiders

Word onderdeel van een wereldwijd, ambitieus en optimistisch team dat werkt aan architectonische en stedenbouwkundige vraagstukken over de hele wereld. Je werkt samen met professionals uit verschillende disciplines, van ontwerp tot business support.

Stagevergoeding

Je ontvangt een aantrekkelijke stagevergoeding van €1.100 per maand, plus een vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer (via een NS-Business Card of kilometervergoeding).

Een levendige werkcultuur

Ervaar een dynamische en internationale werkomgeving met regelmatige excursies, feesten en teamactiviteiten, waaronder deelname aan de Rotterdam Marathon en andere sportevenementen.

Gezond en actief blijven

Geniet van betaalbare vegetarische lunches op kantoor (€4,30 per dag), een ruime bijdrage aan je Urban Sports Club-abonnement en toegang tot OpenUp, ons platform voor mentaal welzijn.

Een inspirerende werkplek

Werk vanuit ons kantoor in de levendige Rotterdamse wijk Blaak, op loopafstand van station Rotterdam Blaak. Een inspirerende omgeving in het hart van de stad.


Wij zijn op zoek naar een fulltime architectuurstagiair (40 uur per week) die van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027 bij ons op kantoor komt werken (5 dagen per week op locatie) voor een uitdagende stageperiode van 6 maanden.

Meer specifiek zoeken wij studenten met:

  • Sterke ontwerp- en CAD-vaardigheden.

  • Goede beheersing van Adobe Suite en sterke 2D- en 3D-visualisatievaardigheden (vermeld in je sollicitatie duidelijk je ervaring met de verschillende softwareprogramma’s).

  • Het vermogen om goed samen te werken in internationale teams.

  • Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van de Engelse taal; aanvullende talen zijn een pré.

  • Werkgerechtigdheid in Nederland (bijvoorbeeld door EU-burgerschap, een Nederlandse verblijfsvergunning of een Working Holiday-visum). Indien van toepassing kan MVRDV ondersteuning bieden bij de visumaanvraag voor niet-EU-burgers. Dit is afhankelijk van het voldoen aan alle vereisten van de Nederlandse Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND). Zorg er daarom voor dat je de juiste gegevens invult in je sollicitatie.

  • Gedurende de volledige stageperiode ingeschreven staan als student (een bewijs van inschrijving is vereist).

Sluit je bij ons aan en doe waardevolle praktijkervaring op in een dynamische en collaboratieve werkomgeving, waar jouw ideeën ertoe doen en jouw ontwikkeling wordt gestimuleerd, of je nu werkzaam bent in design, communicatie, HR, finance of een andere discipline.

Wij kijken ernaar uit je in ons team te verwelkomen!

As a Prediction Model Expert, you bring deep expertise in AI forecasting, software development in Python, backed by a dissertation on prediction models or time series forecasting. You excel at building production-grade prediction engines that detect anomalies, forecast threats, and power proactive threat detection logic at compute scale.

You will be one of Haste's first senior AI researchers pioneering prediction models that anticipate stealthy threats across HPC clusters, AI and quantum workloads before they strike.

Key Responsibilities

  • Predictive Model Development & Engineering: Designing, building, and deploying Machine Learning (ML) and Foundation models to forecast potential security breaches.

Why Join Haste?



If you’ve ever wanted to build the world’s fastest threat detection and hunting platform for the future of compute, this is the place for you. If you want to build technology that pushes the boundaries of cybersecurity for HPC, AI, and quantum environments, this is where you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career.

Technology Transformation - Senior

Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En très forte croissance depuis notre création fin 2009, Eight Advisory compte aujourd’hui plus de 1100 collaborateurs dont 129 associés et continue de se développer. Nous sommes présents en France, Belgique, Allemagne, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Pays-Bas, USA, Espagne, Italie ainsi que dans une trentaine d’autres villes dans le monde à travers notre réseau de cabinets indépendants "Eight International".


Dans le cadre de nos missions, nous axons notre développement sur une approche mixte IT et financière, du diagnostic jusqu’à la mise en place des recommandations et nous intervenons en collaboration étroite avec les membres de la Direction Générale.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.


  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines informatiques et / ou digitaux.

  • Une bonne connaissances des outils présents sur le marché.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux, dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère sera un plus). Vous êtes motivé par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à fort enjeux stratégiques marqués par des opérations de haut de bilan et/ou de retournement et d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions IT, financières et opérationnelles.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - MED
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive - MED

Enterprise Account Executive, TradFi & Web3 Enterprise, MED (France & Italy)

Our Account Executives help organisations adopt digital assets with confidence by connecting their business needs to Chainalysis's blockchain intelligence solutions. They build trusted customer relationships, develop new business, and grow existing accounts through a consultative sales approach.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to cover France, Italy and Malta within our SEMEA team. Your primary focus will be two segments: traditional finance (TradFi), including retail, commercial, private and investment banks, payment and e-money institutions, and asset managers that are launching, supporting or exposed to digital asset activity; and the largest Web3 players, including major exchanges, brokers, custodians, stablecoin issuers and digital asset infrastructure providers operating at scale in France and Italy.

You will own your territory strategy, navigate complex and highly regulated sales cycles, and engage stakeholders across compliance, financial crime, risk, security, procurement, digital assets and executive leadership, from bank CCOs to the compliance and security leaders of large crypto platforms. We measure success through quota attainment, new customer acquisition, and account growth across France and Italy.

In this role, you'll

  • Exceed your sales quota by acquiring new customers and growing existing accounts across France and Italy, with a primary focus on TradFi institutions and large Web3 enterprises.

  • Develop and execute territory and strategic account plans that reflect each market's banking and digital asset landscape, regulatory environment, and buying processes.

  • Build relationships with decision-makers and champions across compliance, AML / financial crime, investigations, risk, security, digital assets teams, and executive leadership, in both TradFi and large Web3 organisations.

  • Create and maintain a qualified pipeline through targeted prospecting, local industry relationships, partner collaboration (consultancies, advisory firms, technology partners), and customer referrals.

  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, working with customers' technical, legal, third-party risk, and procurement teams.

  • Connect Chainalysis solutions to customer outcomes, including managing exposure to crypto-asset service providers and their customers, meeting AML / CFT and sanctions obligations, supporting the safe launch and scaling of digital asset offerings, and investigating illicit activity.

  • Engage customers on how MiCA, the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule), DORA, EU AML rules and evolving French and Italian supervisory expectations affect their business needs, working with Chainalysis specialists where appropriate.

  • Position Chainalysis as a partner for both worlds: help banks build confidence in digital assets, and help large Web3 players meet the compliance expectations of banks, regulators and institutional counterparties. Coordinate with the wider crypto native coverage to avoid overlap on mid-market and early-stage Web3 accounts.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and clear account plans, with consistent visibility into opportunities, risks, and next steps.

  • Work with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to develop proposals and support customer adoption.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings and industry events across France and Italy, sharing market feedback to inform regional positioning and messaging.

We're looking for candidates who have

  • 7+ years of B2B enterprise software or SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to banks or other regulated financial institutions (AML / financial crime, risk, compliance, fraud, or cybersecurity solutions) and/or to large crypto native organisations.

  • A record of exceeding quota through consultative selling, new business development, and account growth in long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Experience developing enterprise accounts in France and/or Italy, with an understanding of local banking and Web3 market practices, procurement and vendor-onboarding processes.

  • A solid understanding of the crypto ecosystem and of the compliance, risk and security challenges facing both banks engaging with digital assets and large exchanges, custodians and infrastructure providers.

  • The ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes for different stakeholders, from compliance officers to CISOs to C-level executives.

  • Experience using a structured enterprise sales methodology to qualify opportunities, develop customer champions, and manage complex deals.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage senior executives and explain complex concepts clearly.

  • Professional fluency in English and either French or Italian, with the ability to sell effectively across both markets.

  • The ability to work independently across a defined territory while collaborating with regional and global teams.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across France and Italy and occasionally elsewhere in the SEMEA region.

Nice to have

  • Professional fluency in both French and Italian.

  • Established relationships within French and Italian banks, payment institutions, large crypto platforms, and financial services associations.

  • Experience selling blockchain analytics, financial crime, KYC / transaction monitoring, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or data analytics solutions to banks.

  • Familiarity with MiCA, the Travel Rule, DORA,European AML requirements, and the roles of relevant French and Italian authorities (e.g. ACPR, AMF, TRACFIN, Banca d'Italia, CONSOB, UIF).

  • Experience selling to banks launching digital asset services (custody, trading, tokenisation, stablecoins), or to large Web3 players serving institutional clients.

  • Experience working with local industry associations, advisory and Big 4 firms, and technology partners to develop a territory.


AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Senior RAM Engineer

Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams.

· Experience with modern European RAM standards: IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L

jobs.title: Projectmanager Datacenters
jobs.description:
Projectmanager Datacenters

Krijg jij energie van het leiden van grote en complexe projecten waarin techniek, samenwerking en commercie samenkomen? Weet jij multidisciplinaire teams mee te nemen en houd je tegelijkertijd grip op kwaliteit, planning, budget en klantbelang? Als Projectmanager Datacenters bij Deerns neem jij de regie over uitdagende advies- en ontwerpprojecten binnen een sector die continu in ontwikkeling is.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Projectmanager Datacenters ben je verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grote en complexe projecten binnen de datacentersector. Je stuurt multidisciplinaire projectteams aan en zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen de afgesproken kwaliteit, planning en financiële kaders worden gerealiseerd.

Daarbij combineer je projectmanagement met technische inhoud. Je begrijpt wat er binnen de verschillende technische disciplines speelt en weet de juiste specialisten met elkaar te verbinden. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder technisch detail uit te werken, maar bent inhoudelijk sterk genoeg om keuzes te beoordelen, risico's te herkennen en richting te geven aan het project.

De datacenterwereld stelt hoge eisen aan onder andere betrouwbaarheid, energie-efficiëntie en veiligheid. Binnen Deerns werken we aan uiteenlopende projecten, van de ontwikkeling van nieuwe datacenters tot uitbreiding, verduurzaming en renovatie van bestaande locaties.

Je bent daarbij niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het project zelf. Ook de samenwerking met de opdrachtgever, het financiële resultaat en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen behoren tot jouw rol.

 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Het leiden en aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams;

  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, planning, budget, scope en projectresultaat;

  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, planningen, begrotingen en voorstellen;

  • Het organiseren en leiden van kick-offs, project- en coördinatieoverleggen;

  • Het tijdig signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en hierop gericht bijsturen;

  • Het afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, architecten, aannemers, installateurs en andere projectpartners;

  • Het onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties;

  • Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en het bespreken van meerwerk en aanvullende opdrachten;

  • Het bewaken van de financiële voortgang en bijdragen aan een gezonde projectmarge;

  • Het bijdragen aan het verbeteren van projectprocessen en onze manier van samenwerken.

 

Het team en de projecten

Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht en multidisciplinair team met een gedeelde passie voor datacentertechnologie en duurzame techniek. Binnen het team komen verschillende expertises samen, waaronder werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, brandveiligheid en duurzaamheid. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en werkplezier staan centraal.

Je werkt aan nationale en internationale projecten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers binnen de datacenterbranche. Daarbij krijg je te maken met complexe technische vraagstukken en verschillende stakeholders. Geen project is hetzelfde en juist die combinatie van techniek, organisatie en samenwerking maakt deze functie uitdagend.

Door jouw ervaring speel je daarnaast een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s en helpt ons om onze projecten steeds slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren.
 
Dit ben jij 

Je bent een ervaren projectmanager die techniek, mensen en commercie met elkaar weet te verbinden. Ook wanneer projecten complex worden, behoud je het overzicht en weet je de juiste prioriteiten te stellen. Je durft beslissingen te nemen, communiceert gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus en creëert duidelijkheid voor zowel de opdrachtgever als jouw projectteam.

Je geeft mensen de ruimte om vanuit hun eigen expertise bij te dragen, maar bent duidelijk wanneer richting of besluitvorming nodig is. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan het project van vandaag: je begrijpt het belang van duurzame klantrelaties en herkent kansen om onze samenwerking met opdrachtgevers verder uit te bouwen.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een technische achtergrond;

  • Ruime ervaring binnen complexe technische ontwerp- en/of adviesprojecten;

  • Bij voorkeur circa 15 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan een belangrijk deel in projectleiding of projectmanagement;

  • Brede multidisciplinaire technische kennis;

  • Ervaring met het aansturen, motiveren en coachen van projectteams;

  • Kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, planning en financiële projectbeheersing;

  • Kennis van relevante contractuele en bouwrechtelijke aspecten;

  • Commercieel inzicht en ervaring met klant- en stakeholdermanagement;

  • Een resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte manier van werken.

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.623 en € 8.033 (op basis van 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en expertise.

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week.

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. 

 
Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work! 

Kennis maken? 

Wil je meer weten over werken bij Deerns? Neem dan contact op met Maarten Borgmeijer (Corporate Recruiter) via +31 6 11 66 75 44. Wil je meer weten over de inhoud van de functie? Neem dan contact op met Ester Vlielander (Unit Director Data Center en Life Sciences) via +31 6 50 73 68 41
