jobs.title: Maryland Remote Licensed Therapist, 1099 Contractor
jobs.description:
Maryland Remote Licensed Therapist, 1099 Contractor

About the Remote Licensed Therapist (1099 Contractor) role at Headspace:

Headspace is currently seeking part-time, independently licensed contractor therapists to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team on a 1099 contract basis.

To get started, we strongly encourage having 10+ hours available per week with full flexibility to adjust; more is always welcome depending on your schedule! Please note that due to care demand and member scheduling fluctuations, it could take a number of weeks to achieve a consistent schedule.

The pay for the Contract Mental Health Therapist ranges from $82-$87 per teletherapy session. Exact reimbursement rates will be determined during the interview process and are based on a number of factors including but not limited to location, licensure type, experience, specializations, languages spoken, and populations treated.

Session length is 60 minutes for an intake and 45 minutes for a follow up appointment, with concurrent note-taking expected and included in the session rate. All Headspace therapists must be licensed and reside in the US. Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.

Why Work on the Headspace Network:

  • Exceptional Care, backed by Clinical Expertise: Bring your deep expertise to a platform that delivers exceptional measurement-based care. Headspaces’ comprehensive training and clinical support teams will partner with you to ensure member success, while our robust quality assurance process ensures ongoing support–enhancing your practice and providing a framework for continuous improvement in clinical outcomes.
  • World Class Content Created by a Beloved Brand: Supplement your member support with thousands of expert-led exercises, mood-boosting meditations, and stress-relieving tools for all of life’s moments. Whether your members report feeling stressed or anxious, need support navigating their caregiver journey, or experiencing grief, our content supports individual goals with tools backed by research and delivered by trained mindfulness experts.
  • Seamless Support for You and Your Members: A dedicated team at Headspace handles the operational details, allowing you to concentrate on what you do best — delivering high quality care. With intentional communication, a suite of administrative and clinical tools, and resources, we ensure providers and members feel supported every step of the way.
  • Education That Empowers Excellence: Benefit from access to a best-in-class training institute that prioritizes pragmatic, evidence-based approaches to transdiagnostic care and culturally responsive practice. Our education program promotes continuous skill development, improving your clinical expertise while expanding your knowledge and capabilities.
  • A Community of Care: Join a network of peers and Headspace experts with opportunities to collaborate, connect, and grow together while delivering on our mission to provide every person access to lifelong mental health support.

What you will do:

  • Provide high quality, innovative, tele-therapy to Headspace patients over a HIPAA compliant video conferencing platform
  • Complete, sign and lock clinical case notes in EMR within 48 hours of session as part of the per-session reimbursement rate.
  • Maintain your personalized database to record proof of licensure, license updates, expiration dates, personal information, etc.
  • Keep your availability calendar up to date
  • Work with a collaborative care team including health coaches, other therapists, psychiatrists, and external care providers

What you will bring:

  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychotherapy to individuals, couples or families
  • An independent clinical license to practice in good standing (without need for clinical supervision), at the Master or Doctoral levelBC-TMH credential, if required by your state of license
  • Ability to offer at least 10 sessions per week for bookings, with the ability to flex up or down as needed
    • Night and weekend flexibility a plus
  • Clinical competence in evidence-based practices (CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, etc.) and measurement-based care
  • Experience with risk management and higher acuity cases
  • Knowledge, ability, and commitment to providing culturally responsive care
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with care delivery technology - various applications, tech tools, google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • A safe secure location with reliable internet connection to provide Zoom-based psychotherapy
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work within interdisciplinary teams

Preferred (if applicable)

  • Licensure in multiple states
  • Licensed psychologist with willingness to apply for (or is already enrolled) with PSYPACT
  • Ability to deliver care to a variety of populations
  • Multilingual
  • Familiarity with the Headspace app and content
  • Willingness to include evening availability in your schedule to support member care flexibility

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to our Privacy Policy. Further, while employees and contractors of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

For how we will use the personal information you provide as part of the application process, please see: https://organizations.headspace.com/page/applicant-notice.

Contract USA

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, United States
jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive, United States

Enterprise Account Executive

Location: Remote New York, NY, Boston, MA, Austin, TX, San Francisco, CA, Chicago, IL

About the job:

Testlio’s fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology - LeoAI EngineTM, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit testlio.com.

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to focus on new business acquisition and open new enterprise logos across product-led companies. In this role, you will be required to be a hunter, to open doors, build a pipeline from scratch, and lead complex multi-stakeholder deal cycles with senior product and engineering executives. Joining our Growth team, you will act as a key revenue driver targeting $300K+ annual contract value opportunities. This is not an account management or renewal-focused role.

Why will you love this job?

  • Drive high-impact deal strategy: You will own complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from initial prospecting to procurement, closing six-figure deals ($300K+ ACV) with product and engineering leaders. Success here looks like someone who can navigate a real sales cycle — multiple influencers, a technical evaluation, procurement, and a business case — not a transactional, single-call close.
  • Autonomy to build from scratch: You get to operate as an entrepreneurial hunter in a defined territory, using your market knowledge to build and execute your own pipeline generation strategy.

Why will you love being a part of Testlio?

  • Great Culture: Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.
  • Remote Work: Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team. Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace.
  • Investment in You: Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.
  • Winning Business: Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Several of our largest clients have been with us for 7+ years, and many spend $500K+/year with Testlio.

What would your day look like?

  • Proactively generate and build net-new sales pipeline in your designated territory through targeted outbound prospecting and network outreach.
  • Lead end-to-end consultative sales processes with senior product, QA, and engineering executives (VP/Director level) at target mid-market and enterprise logos.
  • Formulate and present tailored business cases connecting Testlio's testing solutions to prospects' operational and quality challenges.
  • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder deal execution through technical evaluations, business case approvals, and legal/procurement negotiations.
  • Apply domain insights in key verticals, particularly financial services and retail/B2C, to tailor Go-To-Market messaging and displace competitors.
  • Partner with internal solutions engineering, marketing, and GTM leadership to sharpen territory strategy and deal velocity.

What do you need to succeed?

Technical Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise B2B new business development with a proven record of self-generating pipeline and closing net-new logos.
  • Demonstrated success navigating complex sales cycles and closing deals with $300K+ Annual Contract Value (ACV).
  • Track record of selling software solutions or technical services directly to product management, engineering, or QA leaders.
  • Domain experience selling into financial services, retail, or related high-volume B2C software verticals.
  • Familiarity with the software testing, QA ecosystem, or technical SaaS category sales motions.
  • Proven capability in managing multi-threaded evaluations involving technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.

Human Skills

  • Hunter mindset: Motivated by outbound outreach, initiating cold conversations, and closing new business logos.
  • Strategic problem-solver: Able to quickly digest complex technical environments and articulate business value to senior buyers.
  • Complex negotiation: Experienced in navigating multi-buyer dynamics, technical evaluations, and contract negotiations.
  • Clear communicator: Exceptional ability to lead structured, executive-level discussions and present complex business cases.
  • Resilient execution: Ability to maintain high momentum across multi-month enterprise sales cycles.
  • Adaptable collaborator: Works cross-functionally with pre-sales and marketing to optimize territory engagement.

What is the application process?

At Testlio, we aim to hire individuals who are excited about their role, thrive in a fully remote environment, and have strong long-term potential with our team. Because we are a fully distributed company, our interview process includes conversations with several team members so you can get a well-rounded understanding of the role, the people you’ll work with, and how we collaborate. As a result, our interview process typically takes 3–4 weeks to complete. Interview Process:

  • Application
  • Recruiter interview
  • VP of Sales interview
  • CRO interview
  • Testlio Pitch
  • Reference checks
  • Offer & background check

Diversity and Inclusion Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and 46% of our team members identify as women. For more information, see the DEI section of our website.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff - Operations
jobs.description:
Chief of Staff - Operations

Über Ralph

Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Warum das wichtig ist

Die Verwaltung rund ums Zuhause ist oft frustrierend. Ralph macht Wohnen einfacher, effizienter und wirklich digital – ein echtes „Home in your Pocket“.

Aufgaben

  • Integration & Transformation: Du arbeitest eng mit dem VP Operations daran, neu erworbene Unternehmen sauber zu integrieren und operativ auf Ralph-Standard zu bringen.

  • Process Design: Du entwickelst Playbooks, Standards, Eskalationslogiken und Entscheidungsroutinen für wiederkehrende operative Situationen.

  • Automation: Du identifizierst manuelle, fehleranfällige Abläufe und arbeitest mit Product, Tech und Operations an besseren, automatisierten Lösungen.

  • People & Change: Du begleitest neue Arbeitsweisen, schärfst Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Veränderungen im Team wirklich ankommen.

  • Execution: Du übernimmst wichtige Transformationsprojekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Effizienz, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Escalation Management: Du springst bei komplexen operativen Themen ein, strukturierst Sachverhalte und übersetzt sie in konkrete nächste Schritte.

  • Fixer: Dir ist kein Problem zu groß oder zu klein – du übernimmst Ownership und bleibst dran, bis das Problem kein Problem mehr ist.

jobs.description:
Head of Compliance Monitoring

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Lendable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.

What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

  • Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

  • Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

  • Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

  • Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

  • Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

  • Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

  • Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

  • Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

  • Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

  • Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

  • Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

  • Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities

Highly desirable

  • Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

  • Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

 

Interview process

  • Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

  • 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

  • Final onsite interview:

    • 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

    • 30 minute interviews with CRO

    • 30 minute interview with a product MD

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer (Product Manager)

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.

What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

  • Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

  • Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

  • Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

  • Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

  • Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

  • Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

  • Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

  • Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

  • Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

  • Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

  • Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

  • Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

  • Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

  • Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

  • Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

  • Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

  • Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

  • Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

  • Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.

Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay.

Tooling & observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  • Quick call with the Talent Team (30 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical and Product interview (90 minutes)

  • Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

jobs.description:
Lead Platform Engineer

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Principal Accountabilities

Platform Architecture and Engineering

  • Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

  • Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

    Infrastructure as Code and Automation 

  • Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero. 

  • Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

    Security, Governance, and Compliance 

  • Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards. 

  • Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence. 

  • Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed.

    Platform Operations and Service Ownership 

  • Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements.

  • Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes. 

  • Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation.

    Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems. 

  • Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work.

    Personal Attributes & Experience 

  • A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale.

  • Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions.

  • Line Management Experience

  • Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability. 

  • Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents. 

  • Treats developer experience as a product.

  • Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate. 

  • Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past.

  • Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite. 

  • Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation. 

  • Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things.

    Desirable Experience 

  • Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform. 

  • Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments.

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns. 

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications.

jobs.description:
Assistant(e) Exploitation

Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que Assistant(e) Exploitation. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Notre mission est d'assurer le transport des personnes en situation de handicap, en apportant une aide précieuse à ceux qui en ont besoin. En tant que assistant(e) exploitation, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la coordination efficace de notre service de transport, garantissant une expérience fluide et ponctuelle pour nos clients. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. Rejoignez-nous pour faire une différence significative dans la vie de ceux qui comptent sur notre engagement et notre expertise.

Vos missions

1.Gestion des appels et suivi des transports

  • Répondre aux appels des conducteurs, des usagers, des clients et des différents interlocuteurs.

  • Écouter les demandes, recueillir les informations et apporter une réponse adaptée.

  • Accompagner les conducteurs par téléphone tout au long de leur service.

  • Suivre les tournées et vérifier que les transports se déroulent correctement.

  • Gérer les imprévus : retards, absences, pannes, problèmes de circulation ou changements de dernière minute.

  • Modifier les tournées et répartir les courses si nécessaire.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard ou de changement.

  • Assurer une permanence téléphonique de 10h à 19h , selon l'organisation du service.

2. Assistance aux conducteurs

  • Répondre aux questions et aux demandes des conducteurs.

  • Leur transmettre les changements d'horaires, de trajets ou de prises en charge.

  • Organiser les remplacements en cas d'absence.

  • Vérifier les prises et les fins de service.

  • Faire le lien entre les conducteurs et le service Exploitation.

  • Veiller au respect des consignes et des règles concernant les temps de conduite, de travail et de repos.

3. Gestion des réservations

  • Enregistrer les demandes de transport.

  • Vérifier et valider les réservations selon les règles du service.

  • Ajouter les nouvelles demandes aux tournées.

  • Prendre en compte les annulations et les changements de dernière minute.

  • Adapter les horaires et les trajets pour organiser au mieux les transports.

  • Vérifier que les informations sont correctement enregistrées dans les outils de travail.

4. Relation avec les usagers et les clients

  • Répondre aux demandes par téléphone avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard, de changement ou de difficulté.

  • Traiter les demandes courantes et les réclamations simples.

  • Transmettre les situations particulières au responsable.

  • Noter et suivre les réclamations et les événements importants.

5. Suivi des incidents

  • Appliquer les consignes prévues en cas d'incident.

  • Évaluer la situation et contacter les secours si nécessaire.

  • Prévenir rapidement le responsable.

  • Suivre l'incident jusqu'à sa résolution.

  • Rédiger un compte rendu et conserver les informations nécessaires au suivi.

6. Gestion du stock de téléphones professionnels

  • Suivre le stock de téléphones de l'entreprise.

  • Réceptionner et enregistrer les nouveaux appareils.

  • Identifier chaque téléphone grâce à son numéro de ligne, son numéro de série et son IMEI.

  • Tenir à jour un tableau indiquant les téléphones disponibles, attribués, en panne, en réparation ou hors service.

  • Préparer les téléphones avant leur remise aux salariés et aux conducteurs.

  • Prévoir des téléphones de remplacement.

  • Anticiper les besoins lors des nouvelles embauches ou des changements de poste.

Profil recherché

  • Vous avez une formation en gestion, administration, transport ou organisation.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise au téléphone et vous vous exprimez clairement.

  • Vous aimez le contact avec les autres et savez répondre avec calme et courtoisie.

  • Vous savez gérer plusieurs demandes en même temps et garder votre calme en cas d'urgence.

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), sérieux(se), réactif(ve) et savez prendre des initiatives.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'informatique et les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel.

  • Vous apprenez facilement à utiliser de nouveaux logiciels et outils numériques.

  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et communiquer avec différents interlocuteurs.

Une première expérience dans le transport, la régulation, la gestion des appels ou un service d'exploitation serait appréciée.

Les qualités importantes pour ce poste : le sens du contact, une bonne élocution, la réactivité, l'organisation, la patience et le sérieux.

wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
jobs.description:
wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken

wo-afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten?
Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes.

Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig?

Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water.

Je gaat onder andere:

  • bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid;

  • onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten;

  • een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid;

  • de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête;

  • onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn;

  • je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS.

Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren.

In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS.

We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn:

  • Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS

  • Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS

  • Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten.

  • Je kunt goed programmeren in R.

  • Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen;

  • jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse;

  • jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt;

jobs.title: Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol
jobs.description:
Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol

Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol

Locatie: Haaften | 32–40 uur | Start: februari, maar mag ook per direct!

Wat jij tijdens je stage maakt wordt straks écht gebruikt op onze bouwplaatsen

Hoe ziet een goed ingerichte bouwplaats eruit? Waar hoort de bewegwijzering? Welke uitstraling geven we bouwhekdoeken? Hoe maken we duidelijk wat de standaard is voor veiligheid, afval, parkeren of bezoekers? En vooral: hoe zorg je dat een uitvoerder niet eindeloos hoeft te zoeken, maar in één oogopslag weet wat nodig is en welk materieel daarbij hoort?

Dat willen we bij Dura Vermeer vastleggen in één Bouwplaatsprotocol: een praktische handleiding én visuele standaard voor de bouwplaats. Het laat zien hoe we onze bouwplaatsen herkenbaar, netjes, veilig en slim inrichten. En dat protocol ga jij helpen maken.

Dit maakt deze stage interessant:

Je zit tijdens deze stage precies tussen communicatie, ontwerp en de praktijk van de bouw in. De ene dag praat je met een uitvoerder over wat er wel en niet werkt. De volgende dag orden je alle informatie die al binnen Dura Vermeer beschikbaar is. Daarna schrijf je een richtlijn zo dat iemand hem in een paar seconden begrijpt en zet je die in Adobe InDesign om in een pagina die ook visueel klopt.

Je hoeft dus niet te kiezen tussen schrijven of ontwerpen. Je doet allebei.

Dit ga je doen:

  • bestaande richtlijnen en informatie binnen Dura Vermeer verzamelen en structureren;

  • bekijken hoe bouwplaatsen nu worden ingericht en waar collega's in de praktijk tegenaan lopen;

  • praten met uitvoerders en collega’s binnen Dura Vermeer Materieel;

  • bepalen welke onderwerpen, standaarden en middelen in het Dura Vermeer-protocol thuishoren;

  • foto's, illustraties, iconen, tabellen en andere visuele middelen maken en inzetten om informatie snel duidelijk te maken;

  • waar nodig nieuwe communicatiemiddelen of formats ontwikkelen;

  • het complete protocol vormgeven in de huisstijl van Dura Vermeer;

  • kritisch testen of iemand op de bouwplaats er ook daadwerkelijk snel mee kan werken en het protocol op basis van deze feedback verbeteren.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om na te denken over vragen als: hoe maken we een document van deze omvang prettig om te gebruiken? Wat moet je laten zien in plaats van uitleggen? Welke informatie hoort bij elkaar? Welke dingen helpen een uitvoerder echt verder?


Wat breng jij mee

Voor deze opdracht zoeken we niet alleen iemand die mooi kan vormgeven. En ook niet alleen iemand die goed kan schrijven. Juist de combinatie is belangrijk.

Jij:

  • vindt het leuk om veel informatie terug te brengen tot een logische structuur. Je kunt een technisch verhaal begrijpelijk opschrijven en hebt tegelijkertijd oog voor typografie, beeld, hiërarchie en vormgeving;

  • volgt een hbo-opleiding zoals Communicatie, Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Media & Design, Crossmedia Design, Marketingcommunicatie, Visual Communication/Graphic Design of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • schrijft helder en foutloos Nederlands;

  • kunt werken met Adobe Creative Suite;

  • kunt zelfstandig informatie ophalen, ordenen en keuzes onderbouwen;

  • vindt het leuk om collega's uit verschillende vakgebieden te spreken en hun kennis te vertalen naar een bruikbaar eindproduct.

 

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Een afstudeer- of meewerkstage met duidelijke opdracht en zichtbare impact;

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invulling;

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 700,- per maand; 

  • Begeleiding vanuit communicatie en nauwe samenwerking met collega's uit de praktijk;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen van de bouwplaats én de materieeldienst.

Waarom dit interessant is

Je werkt niet aan een onderzoek dat in de la verdwijnt, maar aan een product dat straks op al onze bouwplaatsen zichtbaar is. Je combineert analyse, creativiteit en praktijk en levert iets op wat direct gebruikt wordt door uitvoerders en projectteams.

Interesse?

Wil jij bijdragen aan de uitstraling en kwaliteit van onze bouwplaatsen?
Solliciteer en laat zien hoe jij structuur en creativiteit samenbrengt.

Meer weten?

Vragen over de vacature? Neem contact op met recruiter Sharon Kuling via 06 185 082 82 (bellen of WhatsApp) of mail naar

jobs.title: VP of People (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
VP of People (Remote, US)

About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

The Opportunity

Maze is looking for a VP of People to lead our global People function and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive team.

We're at an exciting point in our journey. We've built a strong foundation of People programs and practices, and we're entering a new chapter as we continue to grow our core business while building new opportunities in AI-powered research.

This is an opportunity to shape how we operate, lead, and grow through that evolution. You'll help us make thoughtful decisions about our organization, develop strong leaders, attract and retain great talent, and build a culture where people can do their best work.

We're looking for someone who understands that a great People function is both a strategic business partner and an operationally excellent team. You'll be equally comfortable advising the CEO on organizational strategy, coaching a manager through a difficult conversation, and rolling up your sleeves to solve a problem.

About the Role

Reporting directly to our CEO, you'll be a member of Maze's executive team and lead a small, experienced People team spanning Talent Acquisition and People Operations. You'll inherit a team that has built a strong operational foundation and takes real ownership of its work. Your role is to invest in their growth, empower them to lead in their areas of expertise, and create opportunities for them to expand their impact as the business evolves.

Your scope will cover the full employee experience, including talent strategy, organizational design, compensation and benefits, performance, leadership development, employee relations, and culture.

You'll also play a broader role in how Maze operates, partnering with executive leaders to strengthen decision-making, organizational alignment, and execution across the business.

We're a globally distributed, remote-first company, so you'll bring an understanding of what it takes to build connection, accountability, and consistent practices across geographies.

What you'll do

Be a strategic partner to the business

  • Partner closely with the CEO and executive team to shape organizational strategy, business priorities, and leadership effectiveness.

  • Guide organizational design, workforce planning, and change management as Maze evolves.

  • Bring sound judgment, business acumen, and a thoughtful perspective to complex people and business decisions.

  • Help strengthen how our executive team operates, makes decisions, and communicates across the company.

  • Bring a global perspective to executive decisions, surfacing the employment, compliance, and cultural implications across the countries where we operate before decisions are made.

Lead, develop, and empower the People team

  • Lead and develop a talented People team, building on their strengths and creating meaningful opportunities for growth.

  • Foster a culture of trust, autonomy, and accountability where team members are empowered to own decisions, solve problems, and lead within their areas of expertise.

  • Act as a coach and thought partner, helping the team navigate challenges, build new capabilities, and expand their influence across the business.

  • Set clear priorities and create the space, resources, and support the team needs to do impactful work without unnecessary complexity.

Build and develop a high-performing organization

  • Lead our talent strategy, ensuring we're attracting, hiring, and retaining the people needed to achieve our business goals.

  • Partner with leaders to build strong teams, clarify expectations, and develop managers who bring out the best in their people.

  • Evolve our performance management, career development, and recognition programs to reinforce accountability and meaningful impact.

  • Use engagement data, employee feedback, and business context to identify opportunities to improve the employee experience.

Own compensation, benefits, and People operations

  • Navigate complex employee relations and employment matters with sound judgment, empathy, and consistency.

  • Oversee our global total rewards strategy, including compensation, equity, benefits, and pay transparency.

  • Ensure our People operations are efficient, scalable, and compliant across the countries where we operate.

  • Partner closely with Finance on headcount planning, compensation strategy, and responsible investment in our team.

Shape our culture through growth and change

  • Help preserve and evolve what makes Maze special as our business strategy and organization change.

  • Build trust through clear communication, transparency, and thoughtful change management.

  • Create meaningful opportunities for connection, recognition, and collaboration across a distributed team.

  • Help leaders translate our values into everyday decisions, behaviors, and ways of working.

Build a modern, AI-enabled People function

  • Bring an AI-first mindset to how the People team operates, identifying ways to simplify work, improve decision-making, and increase our impact.

  • Use technology, data, and automation to make People programs more effective and scalable.

  • Champion effective AI use across Maze, helping teams and leaders move beyond basic prompting to workflows and automation that make a real difference in how they work.

What success looks like

Success in this role means building on an already strong foundation while helping Maze navigate its next stage of growth.

In your first year, you'll have:

  • Established yourself as a trusted thought partner to the CEO and executive team, bringing clarity and sound judgment to important business decisions.

  • Built a strong partnership with the existing People team, helping each person grow in their role, increase their ownership, and feel empowered to make meaningful contributions to the business.

  • Built strong relationships with managers across Maze, becoming a go-to partner who helps them navigate team challenges, difficult conversations, and change.

  • Strengthened our hiring, performance, development, and total rewards programs to retain our people and land the strategic hires that matter most.

  • Helped build a culture where employees understand our direction, feel connected to our mission, and know what's expected of them.

  • Brought an AI-first approach to the People function, streamlining how we work so the team can spend more time on high-impact work.

About you

We know great People leaders come from different backgrounds. These are the experiences and qualities we think will help someone thrive in this role, but we encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box.

  • Experienced People leader. You bring significant experience leading People functions in high-growth, venture-backed environments, ideally within SaaS or technology companies.

  • Business-minded executive partner. You understand how businesses operate, connect People decisions to company outcomes, and can confidently challenge and advise senior leaders.

  • Comfortable with complexity and change. You've helped organizations navigate growth, restructuring, or strategic shifts, balancing business needs with care for employees.

  • Strong across the People function. You have meaningful experience in organizational design, talent strategy, total rewards, performance management, and employee relations.

  • Experienced in global, distributed teams. You understand the complexities of supporting employees across countries, particularly the US and UK/Europe, and know how to navigate local employment requirements.

  • A builder and an operator. You can set a long-term strategy while staying close enough to the details to ensure excellent execution. You're comfortable leading a lean team and know how to prioritize for impact.

  • AI-forward and curious. You actively use AI in your work and are excited about how it can transform the way People teams operate.

  • An exceptional communicator. You bring clarity to complex situations, communicate with warmth and candor, and build trust across all levels of an organization.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience supporting a company through a significant business model evolution or the launch of a new business line.

  • Experience with modern People technology, including Rippling, Ashby, Oyster, or similar platforms.

  • Experience working directly with a founder or CEO in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience building with AI, not just using it, including creating your own Claude workflows and automations and connecting AI to the systems your team uses every day. Bonus if you can show us how it’s changed the way you work.

Why Maze

At Maze, we're building the future of research and helping companies make better decisions by connecting them more closely with the people they serve.

You'll join a team that values curiosity, transparency, thoughtful experimentation, and meaningful impact. You'll have a seat at the table, a strong foundation to build from, and the opportunity to influence not just how we support our people, but how Maze operates and grows.

If you're excited about building a modern People function, navigating meaningful business challenges, and helping a talented team do its best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. Rather than bedside or facility work, you'll support patients remotely across the full arc of their care. Untangling complicated health situations, moving them toward their wellness goals, and knocking down the Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) that get in their way. The job rewards people who listen closely and then actually do something about what they hear.

Worth flagging up front: This is a 1099 Contract position, benefits are not included. It is simply a flat hourly rate. You control your calendar. Full-time, part-time, or somewhere in the middle. The role is entirely remote. You'll connect with patients by video or phone, never in person.

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Senior Projektmanager:in (m/w/d) – Digitalisierung & Insurance Solutions

Über uns

Die red6 enterprise software GmbH ist ein Unternehmen im HanseMerkur-Konzern und spezialisiert auf die Beratung und Umsetzung von digitale Business- und Insurance-Lösungen. Wir entwickeln innovative, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen und begleiten unsere Kunden von der Idee bis zum Livegang. Dabei setzen wir auf neueste Technologien und agile Methoden.

Teamgeist, Selbstorganisation und Agilität prägen unsere red6-Arbeitskultur. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir gemeinsam die digitale Zukunft und fördern die persönliche Weiterentwicklung aller Teammitglieder. Als Senior Projektmanager:in (m/w/d) verantwortest du komplexe IT-Projekte im Bereich der Anwendungsentwicklung und treibst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden deren digitale Transformation aktiv voran. Dabei gestaltest du sowohl die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systemlandschaften als auch die Entwicklung neuer Lösungen. Der Einsatz von KI in Geschäfts- und Kernprozessen gewinnt dabei zunehmend an Bedeutung.

Deine Aufgaben

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)
jobs.description:
Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team. You'll play an important role in shaping the customer experience after they take out a loan: from how we engage with customers and manage payments, to how we support those who experience financial difficulty.

APMs at Lendable take ownership of their product changes, working closely with teams across Engineering, Credit, Finance and Operations to solve problems and take the business to the next level.

You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, scale impactful products, and help shape the future of our lending experience. If you're excited by fintech and enjoy turning data and customer insight into great products, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll work on

  • Improving repayment performance: Running experiments to help more customers pay on time, from choosing repayment dates to how and when we remind people to pay.

  • Personalising customer engagement: Own how we communicate across email, SMS and in-app notifications, testing new messages and improving our tooling.

  • Making loan management easier: Optimising and expanding journeys within the Zable SuperApp, particularly for those who need additional financial support.

  • Using data to drive improvements: Work with Credit and Data Science to identify opportunities and build models to improve payment and servicing outcomes. Build dashboards to track key metrics and measure the impact of what we launch.

  • Testing and learning with customers: Running customer research and testing ideas to understand what people need, how they behave and what works best.

  • Taking products from idea to launch: Working across Engineering, Data Science and Operations to understand the impact of new features, coordinate their rollout and make sure they work for both customers and the business.

  • Increasing impact with AI: Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

What we're looking for

Don't worry if you don't meet every single one of the criteria. We'd love to hear from great candidates who are curious, proactive and excited to learn.

  • Experience: 1–2 years in product, or 2-3 years in strategy, analytics, consulting or similar roles, ideally with experience working closely with product or delivery teams to get things done.

  • Communication: You can clearly explain ideas and requirements to different audiences, from writing specs for engineers to training Operations teams.

  • Curiosity: You ask lots of questions and aren't satisfied until you understand why something is happening.

  • Problem-solving: You enjoy forming hypotheses and finding the quickest way to test them, even if the first version is rough around the edges.

  • Data-driven: You're comfortable working with data and can use SQL or Python to investigate problems and answer your own questions.

  • AI-native: You're already experimenting with AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and are excited to see how far they can take you.

  • Hands-on: You're happy to roll up your sleeves and pick up the small jobs. In a lean product team, no task is beneath your attention.

  • Adaptable: You enjoy variety and like that no two days look quite the same.

  • Bonus: Experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Interview process

  • A quick chat with someone from our Product team to see if the role is a good match

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A take home task; a practical product challenge to complete in your own time

  • Task debrief with the product team

  • Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and UK Loans MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Location

This position is a hybrid role based in London, please note we're unable to provide sponsorship for this position

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations
