jobs.title: Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
jobs.description:
Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity

About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

Ingénieur confirmé géotechnique F/H

En tant qu’ingénieur, chargé d’affaires, vous accompagnez vos clients sur l’ensemble de leurs enjeux liés à la donnée du sous-sol, en solo ou en synergie avec les autres expertises du Groupe.

Du terrain aux logiciels, vous maitrisez la chaine d’essais, savez mobiliser les datas disponibles et les méthodes et outils de calculs pour optimiser et adapter vos études aux besoins de vos clients.

Vos principales missions

1-Pilotage des opportunités et gestion de la relation client

  • vous pilotez l'intégralité du cycle commercial : prises de contact, réponse aux appels d’offres et consultations directes.

  • vous réalisez une analyse approfondie des besoins clients, identifiez et synthétisez les données disponibles.

  • Vous mobilisez un réseau d'experts internes pour concevoir des solutions d'ingénierie intégrées et à haute valeur ajoutée

2-Expertise technique et optimisation des projets

  • vous conduisez des études G1 à G5 sur tous types de projets dont plusieurs G2 PRO : bâtiments, infrastructures, ouvrages souterrains, ouvrages d'art, ect.

  • Vous communiquez régulièrement avec votre client pour s’adapter pleinement à l’étude de ses besoins.

  • Vous définissez et supervisez les programmes d'investigations (sondages, essais, etc) et validez la pertinence des données disponibles pour construire la base de l'étude.

  • Vous élaborez les modèles géotechniques, les hypothèses techniques et les paramètres de calcul en vue d’optimiser les préconisations constructives et les solutions de travaux.

Vos principaux alliés

  • Le savoir-faire et le soutien de notre direction des métiers et de notre direction technique.

  • Une formation aux différentes techniques et outils spécifiques

  • Nos années de référence en matière d’investigations

  • Nos innovations: des tablettes de chantier avec une appli qui connecte terrain et bureau; CLEA, notre atelier de forage, 100% performant, 100% électrique, 100% ergonomique et surtout 100% Fondasol.

  • L’expérience, l’esprit d’équipe et d’entraide des Fondasoliens.

Vos avantages & votre carrière

  • Salaire fixe

  • Prime de vacances

  • Participation et intéressement

  • Possibilité de télétravail jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine

  • Tickets restaurant (12€20 pris en charge par l’employeur à 60%)

  • RTT (8 à 10 jours/an)

  • Mutuelle familiale

  • Contrat prévoyance

  • Actionnariat salarié : 75% du capital du Groupe sont détenus par les collaborateurs

  • Forfait mobilité transport en commun ou covoiture de 50€ par mois

  • Perspectives d’évolution professionnelle avec des mobilités géographiques ou de poste et un accompagnement


Parlons un peu de vous

Vous êtes :

  • Issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou Master en Géotechnique et/ou Génie Civil et/ou Travaux Publics,

  • Vous avez impérativement entre 5 et 10 ans d’expérience en bureau d’ingénierie géotechnique, entreprise de fondations spéciales.

  • À l'écoute de vos clients, vous savez identifier leurs besoins et adapter vos préconisations à leurs enjeux.

  • Dynamique et curieux, vous conjuguez avec aisance autonomie et travail en équipe.

  • Côté technique, vous savez exploiter les logiciels géotechniques.

Ouvert à tous, femmes et hommes de talent, le Groupe Fondasol favorise l'égalité des chances et la diversité.

Envie d’en savoir plus sur nos métiers? Consulter nos vidéos

Alors, prêt à devenir Fondasolien? Nous sommes impatients de découvrir votre candidature.

Qui sommes-nous ?

1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique.

Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets.

Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités…

Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences.

jobs.title: Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact
jobs.description:
Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact

L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€).

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs.

Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement.

Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape.

Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème :

  • L’équipe de gestion

  • Les équipes middle office et conformité

  • Nos investisseurs (LPs)

  • Les entreprises de notre portefeuille

Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin.

Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement.

Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre.


Ce que vous construirez concrètement

Pendant votre stage, vous contribuerez à :

  • Structurer et faire évoluer plusieurs années de données d’investissement, impact et ESG

  • Participer à la migration de notre socle de données vers une architecture moderne et évolutive

  • Déployer des automatisations permettant de réduire les tâches manuelles et d’améliorer la qualité des données

  • Concevoir les premiers assistants IA internes de la société

  • Créer des outils utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes d’investissement, le middle office et la conformité

  • Participer à la création de portails dédiés aux investisseurs et aux entreprises du portefeuille

  • Contribuer à définir notre feuille de route data & IA pour les années à venir


Vos missions

Les projets seront menés en lien direct avec les équipes d'investissement, d’impact, le middle office et la conformité. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement très transversal, avec une forte autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer aussi bien à la réflexion qu'à l'implémentation des solutions. 

Les missions décrites ci-dessous constituent une feuille de route initiale. Elles évolueront naturellement en fonction de l’avancement du projet, de vos centres d’intérêt et des opportunités identifiées ensemble.

  1. Comprendre et structurer notre écosystème de données

Vous participerez notamment à :

  • Cartographier les bases Airtable existantes et leurs usages

  • Comprendre les flux de données entre les différentes équipes

  • Identifier les redondances, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration

  • Participer à la conception du modèle de données cible

  • Contribuer, le cas échéant, à la migration progressive vers Supabase

  • Structurer les données financières, impact et ESG

  • Définir les règles d’accès et de gouvernance des données

  • Documenter les modèles, processus et bonnes pratiques

L’objectif est de construire un socle de données fiable, partagé et durable.

2. Automatiser les processus clés

Une fois les données structurées, vous contribuerez à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à fluidifier les opérations.

Exemples :

  • Collecte de données auprès des participations, relances automatiques

  • Consolidation de reportings

  • Contrôles de cohérence

  • Gestion documentaire

  • Préparation de certains livrables réglementaires

  • Qualification et enrichissement automatique d'opportunités d'investissement

  • Circulation de l’information entre les outils

Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de workflows no-code et low-code, principalement via N8N et les APIs des différents outils utilisés par la société.

3. Déployer des usages IA concrets

Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui saura identifier où l’IA peut réellement créer de la valeur.

Vous pourrez notamment travailler sur :

  • Des assistants internes connectés à nos bases de données

  • Des outils de recherche documentaire et de gestion des connaissances

  • L'extraction automatique d'informations depuis des rapports, questionnaires ou documents de due diligence

  • La pré-analyse de dossiers d'investissement

  • La génération assistée de reportings, mémos d’investissement et comptes-rendus

  • Des workflows mêlant automatisation et IA

  • L’exploration de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’investissement, à l’impact ou à la conformité

Vous serez encouragé.e à expérimenter, comparer les solutions disponibles sur le marché et proposer vos propres idées.

4. Construire les interfaces et portails utilisateurs

À mesure que les fondations seront en place, vous participerez à la création des interfaces permettant aux différents utilisateurs d’accéder simplement à l’information. Cela pourra inclure :

Portail équipe de gestion

  • Suivi des participations

  • Reporting portefeuille

  • Outils internes de pilotage

Portail investisseurs (LPs)

  • Consultation des reportings

  • Suivi des indicateurs de portefeuille

  • Diffusion sécurisée des informations réglementaires

Portail participations

  • Collecte de données

  • Suivi des indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers

  • Partage documentaire

5. Accompagner l’adoption des nouveaux outils

La réussite du projet ne dépend pas uniquement de la technologie. Vous contribuerez également à :

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs

  • Identifier de nouveaux cas d’usage

  • Former les équipes aux outils déployés

  • Produire une documentation simple et utile

  • Diffuser les bonnes pratiques liées à la data et à l’IA

  • Réaliser une veille active sur les nouveaux outils et tendances du marché

Pourquoi ce stage est différent

Vous ne rejoindrez pas une équipe technique isolée mais travaillerez directement avec les équipes métiers :

  • Notre Responsable Conformité & Middle Office

  • Notre Chief Impact Officer

  • Nos Directeur.rices d’investissement

Vous serez exposé.e à des problématiques à la fois stratégiques, opérationnelles et technologiques.

Vous participerez à la transformation d’une société de gestion de l’intérieur, avec une forte autonomie et un impact visible dès les premières semaines.

Les outils et processus que vous contribuerez à construire seront utilisés au quotidien par les équipes, les investisseurs et les entreprises que nous accompagnons.

C’est une opportunité rare de développer une expertise à l’intersection de l’investissement, de la data, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle.

Candidature

Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes expliquant :

  • Ce qui vous attire dans ce projet

  • Un outil, une automatisation ou un usage IA que vous avez déjà mis en place (ou que vous aimeriez explorer)

Pas besoin de lettre de motivation formelle.

Nous privilégions les personnes curieuses, pragmatiques et motivées à construire.


Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse, autonome et orientée solutions.

Vous pourriez être la bonne personne si :

  • Vous êtes en école d’ingénieur, école de commerce, université ou équivalent

  • Vous avez une forte appétence pour la data, l’automatisation et l’IA 

  • Vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux outils

  • Vous êtes capable de transformer un problème métier en solution concrète

  • Vous savez avancer de manière autonome tout en travaillant en équipe

Des compétences ou expériences dans les domaines suivants seront appréciées :

  • SQL et bases de données relationnelles

  • Airtable, Notion, N8N, Make ou outils similaires

  • APIs et intégrations

  • IA générative et prompting

Mais nous accordons autant d’importance à la curiosité, à la capacité d’apprentissage et à l’esprit d’initiative qu’aux compétences techniques.

Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous rejoindrez la Direction Territoires et Expérience clients (DTEX), au sein de l’équipe médico-sociale, en lien étroit avec les équipes sectorielles de la DTEX et la Direction de l’Expertise, de l’Interopérabilité et de l’Innovation (DEII). Vous contribuerez au pilotage national de ViaTrajectoire, le service numérique national d’orientation des personnes dans le système de santé, notamment à la sortie d’hospitalisation et dans les parcours sanitaires et médico-sociaux. Dans un contexte de renforcement du rôle de l’ANS dans la gouvernance du service, vous participerez à structurer son déploiement national, à développer son interopérabilité avec les outils métiers et à favoriser son appropriation par les professionnels, au service de parcours de santé plus fluides et mieux coordonnés.

🎯 Missions principales

1. Contribuer au pilotage stratégique et à la gouvernance nationale de ViaTrajectoire

  • Participer aux instances de gouvernance du service et contribuer à la définition de sa feuille de route stratégique et annuelle, en lien avec les partenaires nationaux.

  • Coordonner les actions nationales et les initiatives de mutualisation, notamment en matière de formation des professionnels et de partage des bonnes pratiques.

  • Recueillir les besoins et les retours du terrain, capitaliser sur les usages et identifier les évolutions permettant d’améliorer le service et ses modules.

2. Piloter l’interopérabilité et accompagner les évolutions du service

  • Prioriser et coordonner les travaux d’interopérabilité de ViaTrajectoire avec les outils métiers, en lien avec la DEII et les acteurs concernés.

  • Contribuer à l’intégration de ViaTrajectoire dans l’écosystème des services socles du numérique en santé et à l’articulation avec les référentiels nationaux, notamment le Répertoire opérationnel des ressources (ROR).

  • Identifier et piloter des expérimentations de nouveaux cas d’usage, analyser les retours d’expérience et formuler des recommandations pour éclairer les décisions d’évolution et de généralisation du service.

3. Piloter le déploiement national et promouvoir les usages de ViaTrajectoire

  • Définir et coordonner les actions de déploiement national, en identifiant les cibles prioritaires, les leviers d’adoption et les freins à lever, en lien avec les acteurs régionaux.

  • Concevoir et piloter des actions de communication et de promotion du service auprès des partenaires institutionnels, des fédérations, des éditeurs et des professionnels du sanitaire et du médico-social.

  • Contribuer au suivi des indicateurs de déploiement, à l’exploitation des données d’usage et à la valorisation des résultats afin d’éclairer le pilotage du service et l’amélioration des parcours.

jobs.title: wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen
jobs.description:
wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen

wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?
Krijg je energie van onderzoek doen, werken met data en programmeren in R?
Wil je jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden inzetten voor een actueel maatschappelijk vraagstuk?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Verhuisketens geven inzicht in de doorstroom op de woningmarkt en zijn daardoor actueel en relevant. Het CBS heeft een methode ontwikkeld om deze ketens in beeld te brengen. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping.

Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?

  • Wat is de invloed van vergrijzing en overlijden van ouderen op de doorstroom en het woningaanbod?

Heb je zelf een goede onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij dit thema, dan is daar ook ruimte voor.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

De afdeling Beleidsstatistiek bestaat uit 70 collega’s verdeeld over Den Haag en Heerlen. Er werken onderzoekers en projectleiders met veel verschillende studieachtergronden binnen onze afdeling. Wij stellen cijfers samen die gebruikt worden voor het ontwikkelen, monitoren en verbeteren van beleid, vaak met een thema-overstijgend karakter. We zijn samenwerkingspartner op het gebied van data-gedreven werken bij overheden.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent bijna klaar met jouw wo master-opleiding in de sociale wetenschappen, demografie, ruimtelijke ordening of een aanverwante opleiding en zoekt een afstudeerstage om je opleiding succesvol af te ronden.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je (enige) ervaring met programmeren in R;

  • kun je zelfstandig onderzoek uitvoeren en uitkomsten analyseren;

  • weet je hoe je met verschillende methoden en technieken onderzoek doet.

Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn enthousiast, proactief en analytisch.

Omdat alle communicatie tijdens de stage – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw vakkennis vergroot en werkervaring opdoet;

  • programmeervaardigheden toepast in de praktijk;

  • leert werken met CBS-data.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

jobs.title: Senior Fleet Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Fleet Manager

Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder!

Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren.

Wat ga je doen?

In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership. 

Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers:

Datagedreven Regie & Strategie:

  • Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses;

  • Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur;

  • Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen);

  • Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner.

Operationele Excellentie:

Om op strategisch niveau te kunnen adviseren, zorg jij dat de basisprocessen, de motor van de afdeling, vlekkeloos verlopen:

  • Triage en analyse: Je overziet de storingsmeldingen en zorgt voor een feilloze initiële beoordeling.

  • Slimme planning: Je overziet de planning van (preventief) onderhoud, altijd met de impact op de 24/7 luchthaven operatie en veiligheid op Schiphol in je achterhoofd;

  • Toetsing en beoordeling: Je beoordeelt complexe reparatie aanvragen kritisch op basis van historie, vastgelegde afspraken en toekomstige inzet van het voertuig;

Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor de rol van Senior Fleet Manager zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je overziet het grote geheel, maar snapt de details die de data beïnvloeden. Verder zien wij graag het volgende terug:

  • Denkniveau: Je beschikt over HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Sterk analytisch: Je bent een kei in het analyseren van data en haalt hier moeiteloos de juiste conclusies en actiepunten uit;

  • Proactieve mindset: Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert kansen en knelpunten voordat ze een probleem vormen;

  • Kennis & Ervaring: Je snapt hoe onderhoudsprocessen (triage, MTTR, MTBF) werken. Ervaring als Fleet Manager is een must en ervaring in de automotive of specifiek de OV-sector (bussen) is een zware pré;

  • Overtuigingskracht: Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt draagvlak creëren en complexe technische of data-gerelateerde zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen aan directie, klanten en leveranciers.

Ben jij klaar voor deze stap als Senior Fleet Manager en wil je bouwen aan de toekomst van ons wagenparkbeheer op Schiphol? Druk dan snel op de sollicitatieknop en laat jouw cv en motivatie achter!

Wat bieden wij

Een leuke en uitdagende baan met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je komt te werken in een professionele en stabiele kantooromgeving. Orion is een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de Pon-onderneming en biedt doorgroeimogelijkheden in de toekomst.

Wat bieden we nog meer voor de functie van Senior Fleet Manager:

  • Een goed salaris tussen de € 4.579,- en € 6.538,- o.b.v. fulltime. Uiteraard is dit afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 28 vakantiedagen* en 6 ADV dagen;

  • Een individueel keuzebudget (o.a. te besteden voor het aankopen van verlof);

  • Directe en korte lijnen; je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Operations;

  • De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken;

  • Een enthousiast, gezellig, compact en ambitieus team;

  • Een ruime Pon-pensioenregeling;

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis waarbij Pon €300 per jaar bijdraagt;

  • Pon Fit: sportieve activiteiten waar je aan kan deelnemen! Van bootcamp tot golfclinic;

  • Korting op eigen producten van Pon (bijv. een nieuwe Gazelle fiets of privé lease auto), €500 per jaar;

  • Lease-a-bike regeling voor het leasen van een Pon-fiets.

Over de organisatie

Orion ontzorgt bedrijven met grote complexe wagenparken door het reparatie- en onderhoudsproces optimaal te structureren.

Binnen het netwerk heeft Orion een 15-tal eigen werkplaatsen onder de labels: AirportPartners, BusPartners en WastePartners. Onze werkplaatsen zijn gevestigd in: Almere, Amersfoort, Badhoevedorp-Schiphol (2 locaties), Ede, Emmeloord, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Leiden, Lichtenvoorde, Middelburg, Montfoort, Oosterwolde, Utrecht en Zwolle. Deze vacature is gericht op ons hoofdkantoor in Barneveld!

Met circa 250 collega’s zetten wij ons dagelijks in om ervoor te zorgen dat onder andere huis en bedrijfsafval opgehaald kunnen worden, vliegtuigen kunnen blijven opstijgen en landen en OV-reizigers in veilige en betrouwbare bussen kunnen reizen. Wij staan midden in de maatschappij en spelen in op trends als verstedelijking, elektrificatie, duurzaamheid en digitalisering. 

Iedereen is welkom !

Bij Orion en Pon maken de mensen het verschil. Wij geloven dat een diverse en inclusieve organisatie zorgt voor meer werkplezier, creativiteit en betere resultaten. Welke achtergrond, leeftijd of identiteit je ook meebrengt: als jij de motivatie en het talent hebt, horen we heel graag van je.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
QA Engineer

About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

jobs.title: GCP - Computer System Validation Specialist (12 month limited-term)
jobs.description:
GCP - Computer System Validation Specialist (12 month limited-term)

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Looking for a new challenge with real impact, ensuring technology meets the highest quality and compliance standards in a regulated environment? As a Computer System Validation (CSV) Specialist, you will play a key role in validating GCP-regulated systems, partnering with IT, Quality, and business teams to deliver compliant, reliable solutions. You'll lead validation activities from planning through execution, influence system quality and integrity, and help drive continuous compliance with industry regulations and best practices.

About the Role:

  • Execute validation activities for computerized systems and software in compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain validation documentation, including validation plans, test scripts, traceability matrices, summary reports, and release documentation.
  • Partner with IT, Quality Assurance, business stakeholders, and external vendors to define validation strategies and ensure successful project delivery.
  • Coordinate and oversee validation testing activities, ensuring requirements are appropriately tested and documented.
  • Manage defects, deviations, and incidents identified during testing, including triage, resolution tracking, and closure documentation.
  • Facilitate review, approval, execution, and post-execution management of validation and qualification documentation.
  • Train and support project teams on validation procedures, tools, documentation standards, and best practices.
  • Provide ongoing guidance on change management for validated systems and stay current with evolving regulatory requirements and industry standards.

What we're looking for:

  • Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Software Development, or a related field with 3-5 years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
    • Experience validating GCP-regulated computerized systems and software, ideally within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other highly regulated industries.
    • Strong understanding of quality system principles, including validation, documentation, change control, training, and audit readiness.
    • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and matrixed environments, building strong relationships with internal stakeholders, business partners, and external vendors.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document, present, and explain technical and compliance-related information.
    • Experience working within Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes; familiarity with automated testing tools and enterprise validation technologies is considered an asset.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

+ Bonus

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

Product Marketing Director

Location

This is a 100% remote role open to candidates based in the United States. Strong preference for candidates based in the Eastern Timezone.

Testlio’s fully managed crowdsourced testing platform, powered by our proprietary intelligence technology - LeoAI EngineTM, integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit testlio.com.

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on Product Marketing Director who understands software testing and quality engineering to turn complex capabilities into compelling customer value. In this builder role, you will connect Marketing, Sales, Product, and Operations/Delivery, establishing a differentiated go-to-market narrative and equipping revenue teams with the sales enablement tools and proof points needed to win. This is a highly strategic individual contributor role.

Why will you love this job?

  • Define and lead GTM narrative: You will serve as a strategic builder, owning Testlio’s positioning and solution messaging while translating AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities into clear business outcomes.
  • Cross-functional impact: You will work directly with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Operations/Delivery leaders to shape go-to-market plays, drive revenue impact, and mentor emerging product marketing talent.

Why will you love being a part of Testlio?

  • Great Culture: Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network.
  • Remote Work: Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team. Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace.
  • Investment in You: Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development.
  • Winning Business: Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Several of our largest clients have been with us for 7+ years, and many spend $500K+/year with Testlio.

What would your day look like?

  • Own Testlio’s product and solution positioning, buyer messaging, value propositions, and competitive differentiation across testing and quality engineering models.
  • Build vertical- and solution-specific pitch decks, case studies, battlecards, objection handling tools, and repeatable sales plays in direct partnership with sellers.
  • Lead cross-functional go-to-market initiatives and product launches in close collaboration with Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations.
  • Capture authentic customer proof points, executive narratives, and industry use cases to build a scalable library of thought leadership and market intelligence.
  • Leverage generative AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, content development, enablement workflows,and knowledge management while maintaining quality standards.
    Establish scalable PMM processes, templates, and measurement practices while mentoring developing product marketing talent.

What do you need to succeed?

Technical Skills

  • 8+ years of progressive B2B product marketing experience within enterprise technology or technology-enabled services.
  • Direct professional experience in software testing, QA, test automation, crowdsourced testing, or quality engineering landscapes.
  • Proven track record developing product positioning, messaging frameworks, GTM strategy, and practical sales enablement assets.
  • Hands-on experience utilizing Salesforce, HubSpot, and modern sales enablement and marketing automation tools.
  • Practical experience incorporating generative AI workflows into content creation, research, and enablement processes.
  • Industry experience or familiarity with payments, financial services, retail, or enterprise SaaS verticals.

Human Skills

  • All-in ownership and a builder mindset that takes proactive initiative to drive projects to completion.
  • Servant leadership approach with a dedication to mentoring team members and supporting cross-functional success.
    Relentless curiosity and commercial acumen to translate complex technical capabilities into strategic customer value.
    Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills tailored for executive and technical audiences.
  • High standards combined with low ego, prioritizing team outcomes and continuous learning.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities across sales, product, marketing, and delivery teams.

What is the application process?

At Testlio, we aim to hire individuals who are excited about their role, thrive in a fully remote environment, and have strong long-term potential with our team. Because we are a fully distributed company, our interview process includes conversations with several team members so you can get a well-rounded understanding of the role, the people you’ll work with, and how we collaborate. As a result, our interview process typically takes 3–4 weeks to complete.

Interview process:

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) C-UAS
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) C-UAS

EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it — initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk.

You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better — pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment — stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.

  • Own integration with existing mission systems — connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions.

  • Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries — ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.

  • Operate what you deploy — own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable.

  • Generate accreditation artifacts — STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments.

  • Represent the mission hero to product and engineering — document issues, write postmortems, recommend operator improvements, and communicate field challenges to the platform engineering team.

  • Train and transfer knowledge — develop runbooks, architecture documentation, working sessions, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable mission teams to operate independently.

  • Mentor junior Data Engineer FDEs — pair on complex problems, review integration designs, and help engineers develop technical judgment without direct people-management responsibilities.

Clearance & Travel

  • Clearance: Active TS/SCI required.

  • Travel: Approximately 10%–25%, based on mission and customer requirements.

  • On-site expectations: Ability to work in SCIFs and other restricted environments for days or weeks when required for integration, incident response, training, or knowledge transfer. Most work is performed remotely.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience working in tactical edge and interoperable mission environments, including TAK Server administration, ATAK/WinTAK, tactical communications, and disconnected or air-gapped systems.
  • Production experience with modern data platforms, including lakehouse technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi), object storage (Ceph or S3-compatible), PostgreSQL, and analytical query engines such as Trino, DuckDB, ClickHouse, or Spark SQL.
  • Experience with streaming and data integration technologies, including Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms, stream processing, change data capture (CDC), and integration of legacy systems into modern data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building, scheduling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovering production data pipelines using Airflow, Dagster, Argo Workflows, or comparable orchestration tools.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, cataloging, access control, and auditability, including REST catalogs, ABAC/RBAC, OIDC/OAuth, and data lineage.
  • Strong SQL proficiency and experience designing data models and schemas for analytical and operational workloads.
  • Hands-on production Kubernetes experience, including deployments, operators, CRDs, storage classes, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong Linux, containerization, networking, TLS, and secrets-management fundamentals.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and GitOps deployment practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex software and data integrations across multiple systems in secure, disconnected, or mission-constrained environments.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with mission operators, program engineers, and technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to changing mission requirements, and deliver practical solutions in environments where established documentation or processes may not exist.
  • Experience mentoring engineers through technical problem-solving, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience administering TAK Server and supporting ATAK/WinTAK integrations in operational environments.
  • Experience with Link 16/TADL-J network operations and message-level analysis.
  • Familiarity with NIPR/SIPR environments, SATCOM, multi-band radios, and tactical communications interoperability.
  • Direct experience integrating C-UAS sensors, effectors, computer-vision-enabled interceptors, or other autonomous and unmanned systems.
  • Experience with Strimzi-managed Kafka on Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, or similar streaming and CDC technologies.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL extensions such as pgvector and open-source catalog technologies including Iceberg REST, Polaris, Gravitino, or Nessie.
  • Familiarity with the CNCF ecosystem and open-source infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience deploying or supporting software in DoD IL4/IL5 environments, including STIG compliance, cATO processes, FIPS requirements, and accreditation documentation.
  • Experience with air-gapped software delivery, Zarf packaging, cross-domain data movement, or DDIL operating conditions.
  • Experience supporting operational DoD users through field integration, incident response, training, and knowledge transfer.

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive, and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

jobs.title: Compliance Lead - CMMC (NIST SP 800-171)
jobs.description:
Compliance Lead - CMMC (NIST SP 800-171)

Role Description

We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would.

This is not a coordination role. The Compliance Lead scopes the assessment boundary, authors the System Security Plan and supporting documentation, directs and where needed performs control implementation, assesses the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide, and stands next to the customer during the assessment. They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. Customer environments vary: Windows and macOS fleets, GCC High and Google Workspace tenants, Jamf and Intune, cloud and on-prem enclaves. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them.

Responsibilities

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers for the life of the engagement: run kickoff, working sessions, and status reporting; answer CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 questions directly and accurately without escalation.
  • Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams.
  • Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards.
  • Author and maintain the System Security Plan, policies and procedures, POA&M, and evidence library at the assessment-objective level; score self-assessments and SPRS submissions under the DoD Assessment Methodology and 32 CFR Part 170.
  • Implement the technical controls hands-on in the customer tenant: identity, MFA, and conditional access in Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity; least privilege and privileged-account separation; data protection in Microsoft Purview or Google Workspace DLP; FIPS-validated encryption; configuration baselines. Decide which requirement each setting satisfies and why, and split the heavier build work with the Technical Implementation Engineer.
  • Stand up and operate endpoint management across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise): enrollment, compliance policies, CIS or DISA STIG baselines, BitLocker and FileVault, patching, and removable-media control.
  • Build the logging and monitoring stack the AU, RA, and SI practices require: centralized audit logging and alerting in a SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk, or similar), log retention and review cadence, vulnerability scanning and remediation tracking, and backup and recovery verification.
  • Assess the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide using examine, interview, and test methods; run the pre-assessment readiness review and close gaps before the C3PAO arrives.
  • Prepare customers for C3PAO assessments and support them during assessment week: evidence presentation, interview coaching, assessor questions, and post-assessment POA&M closeout.
  • Run sustainment for customers: continuous monitoring cadence, change reviews, annual affirmations, and reassessment readiness.
  • Improve the practice: turn repeatable work into templates, checklists, and automation, and contribute domain content to the team's internal AI tooling.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience taking defense contractors through NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 end to end, from scoping through assessment, including at least one organization you personally led through a successful C3PAO or DIBCAC assessment as the consultant, assessor, or internal compliance lead.
  • Proven ability to write assessor-ready documentation: System Security Plans at the assessment-objective level, policies and procedures, POA&Ms, and data-flow and network diagrams.
  • Hands-on experience implementing NIST SP 800-171 technical controls yourself in Microsoft 365 GCC High (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Defender) or Google Workspace (Admin console, Cloud Identity, context-aware access, endpoint management): the admin-console work, not only the policy; able to validate what an implementation engineer built rather than accept a screenshot.
  • Endpoint management experience across Windows and macOS (iOS and Android a plus) with at least one of Microsoft Intune or Jamf: enrollment, compliance and configuration policies, disk encryption, patching, and hardening baselines.
  • Experience centralizing audit logs and alerts in a SIEM or log platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk, or similar) and operating vulnerability scanning, patch management, and backup to satisfy the AU, RA, SI, and MP practices.
  • Working knowledge of networking and perimeter controls (firewalls, VPN and secure remote access, segmentation, DNS, wireless), enough to scope the boundary and verify the SC practices.
  • Customer-facing lead: runs meetings, explains requirements in plain terms to executives and IT staff, documents decisions, pushes back constructively, and delivers without close supervision.
  • Ability to run multiple concurrent engagements (typically 4–6), track milestones, and report status in a remote, asynchronous environment (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace).

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • CMMC Certified Assessor (CCA) strongly preferred; CMMC Certified Professional (CCP) at minimum. Lead CCA designation or Registered Practitioner Advanced (RPA) a plus.

This leader will own the global strategy and execution to ensure GSIs understand, adopt, and embed Keyfactor solutions within their enterprise service offerings and solution architectures.

Strategic Leadership

  • Advocate for GSI partnerships across the organization.

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.

jobs.title: Clinical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Clinical Project Manager

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Clinical Project Manager to oversee the planning, execution, and successful delivery of clinical research projects. In this role, you will coordinate cross-functional teams, manage project timelines and deliverables, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain strong relationships with sponsors and clients.

The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with a collaborative approach to achieving project objectives. This is a home-based opportunity with occasional travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of assigned clinical research projects, ensuring project objectives and deliverables are achieved.

  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams to ensure activities comply with applicable regulations, industry guidelines, corporate policies, and quality standards.

  • Oversee project operations, budgets, regulatory requirements, and patient safety to maintain operational and financial integrity throughout the project life cycle.

  • Manage the development, maintenance, and appropriate disposal of essential clinical study documents, data, equipment, and tools, including protocols, SOPs, informed consent forms, and case report forms (CRFs).

  • Assign, track, and oversee interdisciplinary activities, including site monitoring, database development, data collection, adverse event management, statistical analysis, and clinical study reporting.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors and clients, proactively managing expectations, resolving project-related issues, and maintaining effective communication.

  • Organize and facilitate project meetings, prepare investigator updates, and provide regular project progress and status reports to relevant stakeholders.

  • Support site and patient recruitment strategies, stakeholder training initiatives, and the development of study-related communication materials.

  • Participate in regulatory submissions, audits, third-party vendor selection, and other activities required to support successful project delivery.

  • Monitor team performance, project milestones, and deliverable quality to ensure alignment with sponsor expectations, project requirements, and regulatory standards.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, preferably Health Sciences, Clinical Research, or a related discipline.

  • 1–3 years of experience in clinical study management, with exposure to clinical research project coordination and execution.

  • Strong understanding of clinical research processes, regulatory requirements, quality standards, and study documentation practices.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple tasks, track deliverables, and meet project deadlines.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with sponsors, clients, investigators, and cross-functional teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative working relationships, encourage teamwork, and coordinate interdisciplinary project activities.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a commitment to maintaining accuracy, compliance, and high-quality project outcomes.

  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to proactively identify and address project challenges.

  • Commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and adapting to evolving project and organizational requirements.

  • Fluency in English, including reading, writing, and speaking, with the ability to work effectively in a home-based environment and travel occasionally as required.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Please note that the salary range may vary depending on the country in which the position is based.

Performance-Based Incentive Program

At Alimentiv, we recognize and reward great performance. In addition to a competitive salary, eligible employees can participate in our Short-Term Incentive Plan (STIP), which offers the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on individual contributions, team achievements, and company performance.

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.
